ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can assist with lesson preparation and grading, but teachers remain responsible for classroom interaction and educational judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 10,700 postsecondary agricultural sciences teachers employed in 2024, rising to a projected 11,200 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 500 jobs and about 800 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $86,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary agricultural sciences teachers, but it will assist with lesson preparation, question generation, and grading. Teachers shift from delivering information toward developing thinking and conducting research. People who only read slides face pressure, while strong researchers and mentors become more valuable.
ai_s2_auto: Smart test assembly from question banks
ai_s3_list: Classroom interaction: people create the spark.
Educational judgment: people provide the conscience.
Research guidance: people set direction.
Laboratory instruction: people provide hands-on expertise.
Passing on values: people lead by example.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. The core work of education is difficult to replace, while administrative tasks accelerate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Reading slides is vulnerable, not teaching and mentoring. Deep subject expertise and strong mentoring skills become scarcer as technology improves. People who only repeat textbooks face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through doctoral study, publish early, and develop a grant record.
Advance from teaching into research and mentoring, and develop a specialization.
Highlight teaching and research, and specify which students you have mentored.
Evaluate candidates on subject depth and educational ability; professionals who can carry both teaching and research responsibilities merit established positions.

ai_s7_trends: Widespread adoption of smart lesson planning.
Agricultural vocational education expands.
AI research assistance enters wider use.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 备课与批改能被辅助，但课堂互动与育人判断，还是教师扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年农业教师在岗约 1.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.12 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农学高校教师，但会辅助备课、出题与批改。教师从「讲知识」转向「带思考、做科研」，真正被挤掉的是纯念课件，会育人又会科研的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 课堂互动：火花靠人。
育人判断：良知靠人。
科研指导：方向靠人。
实验带教：手感靠人。
价值传递：身教靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 2/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的教学区——育人核心难被替，但事务性工作在加速。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光几乎零风险：被替代的是「念课件」，不是「教书育人」的岗位。专业深、会带人的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会照本宣科的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读博打底，早点发论文攒基金。
从讲课升级成科研 + 带教，攒方向。
突出教学与科研，写清带过哪些学生。
选人看专业深度与育人，能扛双肩的值得给编制。

ai_s7_trends: 智能备课普及。
职教涉农扩张。
科研辅助上岗。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Digital resources can cover theory, but teachers still correct practical techniques, enforce safety, and spark student interest.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 14,000 Career/Technical Education Teachers, Middle School were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 13,800 by 2034, a net decrease of about 200 jobs, with approximately 900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $63,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Career/Technical Education Teachers, Middle School, but it will reduce theory-only instruction. Online resources take over knowledge delivery, shifting teachers from lecturing toward practical guidance, hands-on correction, and career exploration. Teachers who only read slides face replacement. Those who lead practical training and inspire interest are more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Practical correction: people guide technique.
Safety oversight: people monitor the site.
Sparking interest: people motivate students.
Career guidance: people support planning.
Individualized teaching: people observe each student.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means digital resources accelerate theory instruction while people remain essential for practical training and safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces reading slides, not leading practical training and inspiring interest. Teachers who stay engaged in workshops and motivate students become scarcer as efficiency rises. Textbook-only instructors face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: People with occupational skills can combine teacher education with CTE. Theory-only instruction is shrinking in the AI era, so develop practical coaching ability early.
Move beyond lecturing into practical training + sparking interest, and learn safety and guidance skills.
Highlight occupational expertise and examples of teaching students, including the skills you have taught.
Do not hire on education alone. Evaluate whether candidates will work closely with students in practical training. Core teachers who inspire interest are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: CTE policy provides support.
Practical-training simulations are spreading.
Teachers who lead practical training are more sought after.

body: Career/Technical Education Teachers, Middle School provide introductory skills and career-exploration courses. They teach theory, guide practical training, provide safety education, and help students explore careers as a foundation for later development.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Digital resources can cover theory, but teachers still correct practical techniques, enforce safety, and spark student interest.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 理论有资源接，但实训纠偏、安全把关、点燃兴趣，还是老师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教育教师在岗约 1.40 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.38 万人，岗位净减约 0.02 万个，年均产生约 0.09 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.36 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代初中职教老师，但会压缩纯理论讲授。在线资源接管知识点，老师从「讲课」挪向「实训指导、动手纠偏、职业引导」。真正被替的是只念PPT的，能带实训能激兴趣的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 实训纠偏：动作靠人。
安全把关：现场靠人。
兴趣点燃：激励靠人。
职业引导：规划靠人。
因材施教：观察靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——理论被资源加速，但实训与安全还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「念PPT」动作，不是「带实训引兴趣」的岗位。能蹲实训、能激兴趣的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会照本宣科。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 有手艺可走师范+职教，AI 时代纯理论在缩，早点练实训带人。
从「讲课」升级成「带实训 + 引兴趣」，学安全与引导。
突出专业与带人案例，写清教过哪些技能。
选人别只看学历，要看能不能蹲实训。能激兴趣的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 职教政策利好。
实训模拟普及。
能带实训的老师更抢手。

body: 初中职业与技术教育教师面向中学生开设技能启蒙与职业体验课程，负责理论讲授、实训指导、安全教育与职业引导，铺垫后续发展。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 理论有资源接，但实训纠偏、安全把关、点燃兴趣，还是老师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: An AI-equipped drone can scan an entire building for cracks in three minutes, but an inspector on site still decides whether a crack requires work to stop.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 147,600 Construction and building inspectors employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 146,500 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,100 jobs, with about 14,800 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $72,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Construction and building inspectors, but it will change how they inspect. Drone surveys, AI image recognition, and mobile records increase coverage and speed. Inspectors move from manual scanning toward site judgment and report decisions. Licensed professionals still interpret codes, assign responsibility, and communicate corrective action.
ai_s2_accel: Use AI image recognition to detect structural defects
Upload inspection data in real time through BIM and mobile tools
Use sensors and the Internet of Things to monitor structural movement
Use historical inspection platforms to anticipate risks
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate inspection records and report templates
Capture drone images and identify cracks
Automatically compare plans with site conditions through BIM models
ai_s3_list: Site judgment: deciding whether cracks, leaks, and deviations are hazards or normal conditions.
Code interpretation: applying written requirements to specific building elements.
Communication: securing contractors' acceptance of corrective action.
Accountability: every signature is a commitment to building safety.
Experience: inspectors recognize more patterns as they see more projects.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places Construction and building inspectors in the moderate AI exposure range. AI can assist heavily with records, images, and reports, but the occupation depends on site judgment and accountability. AI expands what inspectors can see; it cannot sign for building safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Inspectors who use drones and AI imaging can cover several sites, while those who avoid new tools lose ground on efficiency. The durable advantage is judging AI-detected problems accurately, assigning responsibility, and securing corrective action.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When studying architecture or civil engineering, consider construction and supervision as well as design. Gain site experience through internships and pursue relevant supervision or construction credentials. Site inspection rewards care and a strong grasp of codes regardless of gender.

Become fluent with drone inspections, AI imaging, and BIM tools, and add specialized knowledge in fire protection and electrical systems. Move from a single-discipline inspector role toward comprehensive inspection expertise to expand income and career options.

Construction or supervision experience transfers well into inspection. Other career changers should study civil engineering fundamentals, earn the required credential, and start as assistant inspectors. Bring an inspection report or hazard case you completed independently to interviews.
Hire for site experience and accountability, not a stack of credentials. Give teams drones and AI imaging tools to expand inspection coverage per person and improve corrective-action closure.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Capture photos, record locations, and generate reports
Issue real-time settlement and tilt alerts
Use past problems to anticipate risks

ai_s7_trends: Drone and AI imaging become standard on construction sites, shifting inspectors toward data analysis and site decisions.
Stricter quality oversight and more existing-building assessments sustain long-term demand for professional inspectors.
BIM and the Internet of Things connect design, construction, and acceptance data, improving accountability decisions.

body: Construction and building inspectors examine building projects against plans, codes, and public policy. They cover construction quality, structural safety, fire and electrical systems, and final compliance. Site checks, reports, and corrective-action tracking protect building safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: An AI-equipped drone can scan an entire building for cracks in three minutes, but an inspector on site still decides whether a crack requires work to stop.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 无人机能三分钟扫完一栋楼的裂缝，但「这条裂缝要不要停工整改」，还得检查员在现场拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年建筑与施工检查员在岗约 14.76 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.65 万人，岗位净减约 0.11 万个，年均产生约 1.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.21 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代建筑检查员，但会重构检查方式：无人机巡检、AI 影像识别、移动端记录让「看得更多、记得更快」，检查员从「人肉扫描」转向「现场判断 + 报告决策」。规范理解、责任认定、整改沟通这些环节，依然需要持证的专业人员。
ai_s2_accel: AI 影像识别辅助结构缺陷检测
BIM + 移动端实现检查数据实时上云
传感器与物联网监测结构变形
历史检查数据平台化支撑风险预判
ai_s2_auto: 检查记录与报告模板自动生成
无人机影像采集与裂缝识别
图纸与现场自动比对（BIM 模型）
整改通知与流程管理电子化
ai_s3_list: 现场判断：裂缝、渗水、偏差是隐患还是正常。
规范理解：把条文对应到具体部位的能力。
沟通协调：让施工方心服口服地整改。
责任担当：签字就是对工程安全的承诺。
经验积累：看过的工程越多，眼越毒。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明检查的记录、影像和报告环节高度可被 AI 辅助，但整个职业建立在「现场判断 + 责任认定」之上，AI 让检查员看得更多，替代不了替工程安全签字的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：会用无人机和 AI 影像的检查员，一人能管几个工地；不会用新工具的会被效率淘汰。真正的护城河，是把 AI 发现的问题「判得准、定得责、改得动」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学建筑/土木时别只看设计，施工与监理方向同样有前途。建议多去工地实习积累现场感，考下监理或建造相关证书；女孩子也别劝退，现场检查对细心和规范感的要求不分性别。
把无人机巡检、AI 影像和 BIM 工具用熟，补齐消防、电气等专项知识。从「单项检查员」升级成「综合检查专家」，收入和发展空间都会上台阶。
有施工或监理背景的转检查岗很顺；纯转行先读土木基础、考资格证，从助理检查员做起。面试时带一份你独立完成的检查报告或隐患案例，比证书更打动招聘方。
招检查员重现场经验和责任意识，轻证书堆砌；给团队配无人机和 AI 影像工具，能显著提升人均检查覆盖面和整改闭环率。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 外立面与屋面影像采集

ai_s7_trends: 无人机 + AI 影像成为工地检查标配，检查员向「数据分析 + 现场决策」转型。
质量监管趋严与存量建筑体检扩容，专业检查员长期刚需。
BIM 与物联网让「图纸—施工—验收」数据贯通，责任认定更精准。

body: 建筑与施工检查员依据图纸、规范与政策对建筑工程进行监督检查，覆盖施工质量、结构安全、消防电气与竣工合规，通过现场核查、报告出具与整改跟踪保障工程安全。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can remotely control continuous mining machines and automatically log cutting data, but when coal quality changes or the roof makes an alarming sound, an underground operator must still decide how to adjust the settings and whether to stop.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 14,900 machine operators were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 15,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs. The occupation generates about 1,600 openings per year and had a median annual wage of about $63,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Continuous Mining Machine Operators, but it will change how they work. Remote controls and automated mining faces are reducing underground staffing, while systems monitor equipment and log cutting data. Machines cannot replace control in complex geology, diagnosis of unusual equipment sounds, or emergency response. Operators who understand both equipment and intelligent systems are moving from underground drivers to remote-control operators.
ai_s2_accel: Wider adoption of remote-controlled coal mining
ai_s3_list: Feel for cutting controls: equipment feedback tells the operator how deeply and quickly to cut.
On-site judgment of roof and coal conditions: experience guides immediate adjustments when conditions change.
Recognition of unusual equipment sounds: experienced operators hear problems with cutting bits or transmissions.
Emergency response: people handle excess gas levels, roof pressure, and other sudden hazards.
Strict safety compliance: no step can be skipped underground.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means that automation is taking over this occupation's recording and monitoring tasks. Systems collect data, issue alarms, and compile statistics, but people still make operating decisions for the mining machine.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Remote controls and intelligent mining faces will reduce underground staffing, but the operator role is advancing from driving underground equipment to controlling it remotely from the surface. Experienced operators who know the machinery and can learn new systems are central to the transition.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Mining or intelligent-mining programs at vocational colleges and universities offer a standard route. As the industry becomes more intelligent, education and computer skills matter more. Do not focus only on manual roles.

Learn remote-control and intelligent mining systems, then transition from underground driver to remote-control operator. Pursue higher-level qualifications and work toward heading a development crew or becoming a technician.

Mechanical or electrical knowledge is ideal. First complete underground-work certification and start in a support role. Your resume should state your willingness to work underground, the equipment you know, and your safety-training experience.

During the intelligent-mining transition, hiring should emphasize learning ability and safety awareness. The most reliable team combines experienced operators who mentor others with younger workers who learn intelligent systems.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Surface-based remote control of continuous mining machines
Automatic alarms for excess gas levels
Real-time communication between underground and surface teams

ai_s7_trends: Remote control and intelligent mining faces are moving operators from underground workings to surface control centers, advancing the role toward remote operation.
Mining equipment is adopting automation and memory cutting, while on-site judgment in complex geology remains a core human contribution.
As safety regulation tightens, intelligent mines aim to reduce underground staffing. Versatile operators who understand the equipment are increasingly sought after.

body: Continuous Mining Machine Operators run continuous mining machines underground to cut coal and rock and load material. They control cutting direction, depth, and advance speed and coordinate with ventilation, roof-support, and haulage systems to support mine development and coal production.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can remotely control continuous mining machines and automatically log cutting data, but when coal quality changes or the roof makes an alarming sound, an underground operator must still decide how to adjust the settings and whether to stop.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能远程遥控采煤机、自动记录截割数据，但煤质一变、顶板一响，怎么调参数、要不要停，还得靠井下操作员的判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器操作员在岗约 1.49 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.50 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.16 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.34 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代连续采煤机操作员，但会改变作业方式。远程遥控和自动化工作面在减少井下人员，设备状态监测和截割数据自动记录；但复杂地质的操控、设备异响的判断和突发处置，机器替代不了。会设备、懂智能系统的操作员，正从「井下司机」转向「远程操控员」。
ai_s2_accel: 截割参数 AI 优化
ai_s3_list: 截割操控的手感：割多深、走多快，靠对设备的感知。
顶板与煤质的现场判断：一变就调，靠经验。
设备异响的识别：截齿、传动有问题，听得出。
突发状况的应变：瓦斯超限、顶板来压，处置靠人。
安全规程的坚守：井下作业，一步不能省。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的记录与监测环节正被自动化——数据采集、报警、统计都有系统代劳，但采煤机的操控判断还是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化。远程遥控和智能化工作面在推进，井下人员会减少；但操作员的角色在升级——从井下开机器到地面远程操控，会设备、懂系统的老操作员反而是转型主力。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 矿业类院校采矿、智能采矿专业是正规通道。行业在智能化，学历和计算机基础越来越重要，别只盯着体力岗。
把远程遥控和智能化系统学起来，从「井下司机」向「远程操控员」转型。考更高等级资质，往掘进班长、技术员走。
有机械或电气基础最好，先考井下作业证从辅助工做起。简历写清能接受井下作业、懂什么设备、有什么安全培训经历。
智能化转型期，招人要重点看学习能力和安全素养。老操作员传帮带、年轻人学智能系统，是最稳的组合。

ai_s7_trends: 远程遥控与智能化工作面推广，操作员从井下走向地面控制中心，角色升级为远程操控员。
采掘设备向自动化和记忆截割发展，复杂地质的现场判断仍是人的核心价值。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Machines can sweep and wash floors, but cleaners still set the standards for wiping hard-to-reach areas and inspecting rooms.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,356,800 Maids And Housekeeping Cleaners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 1,362,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 6,000 jobs, with around 193,500 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $34,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Maids And Housekeeping Cleaners, but it will reduce physical tasks. Floor sweepers and scrubbers accelerate floor cleaning, shifting cleaners from sweeping toward detailed wiping, room-inspection standards, and linen management. Workers limited to floors face the greatest pressure, while those who can inspect rooms and replenish supplies become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Detailed wiping: people reach hidden corners.
Room-inspection standards: people provide the discerning eye.
Linen management: people control the pace.
Exception handling: people provide the experience.
Guest-experience details: people provide the care.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this career in a physically intensive area with relatively low AI exposure. Equipment only takes over floor cleaning, while detailed work and room inspections still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean zero risk. Technology replaces sweeping and floor washing, not the job of making a room thoroughly clean. Cleaners who can inspect rooms, replenish supplies, and understand the guest experience gain easier and more stable work as equipment becomes widespread.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This field has a low entry barrier. Develop attention to detail and an efficient rhythm. Pure floor sweeping is contracting in the AI era, so begin learning room inspection early.
Advance from floor cleaning to room inspection and linen management, then work toward a floor-supervisor role.
Highlight reliability and room-turnover efficiency, clearly stating the types of properties where you have worked.
When hiring, look beyond physical strength and assess attention to detail. Core workers who clean rooms thoroughly deserve higher piece-rate pay.

ai_s7_trends: Cleaning equipment spreads, reducing floor-cleaning work.
Room-inspection standards remain essential.
Workers skilled in linen management are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器能扫能洗，但死角擦拭和查房标准，还是清洁员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年客房清洁员清洁工在岗约 135.68 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 136.28 万人，净增约 0.60 万个岗位，年均产生约 19.35 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.47 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代客房清洁员，但会压缩体力动作。扫地洗地设备把地面清洁提速，清洁员从扫地带挪向精细擦拭、查房标准与布草管理。真正被挤掉的是只做地面的，会查房能补品的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 精细擦拭：死角靠人。
查房标准：眼光靠人。
布草管理：节奏靠人。
异常判断：经验靠人。
客感细节：用心靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的体力区——设备只吃地面清洁，精细和查房还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没风险：被替代的是扫地洗地动作，不是把房间做干净的岗位。会查房、能补品、懂客感的清洁员，反而随设备普及更轻松也更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这行门槛低，多练细心和节奏，AI 时代纯扫地在缩，早点练查房。
从扫地升级成查房加布草管理，争取领班。
突出踏实和翻房效率，写清做过哪些业态。
选人别只看力气，要看细不细。能把房间做透的骨干值得给计件高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 清洁设备普及，地面缩。
查房标准仍是刚需。
会布草管理的更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Monitoring systems can alert you to unusual noises, but experienced technicians can tell what failed and how to dismantle and repair it by listening with a mechanic's stethoscope.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 57,500 machinery maintenance workers were employed in 2024, declining to a projected 55,900 by 2034. That represents roughly 1,600 fewer jobs, with about 4,800 openings per year and median annual pay of approximately $60,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace machinery maintenance workers, but it will accelerate inspections. Sensors, condition monitoring, and work-order systems speed up repetitive tasks, shifting workers from making rounds toward diagnosis, emergency repair, root-cause analysis, and maintenance optimization. Pure inspection and recordkeeping roles are being squeezed out, while people who diagnose faults and complete urgent repairs become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Fault diagnosis: people identify unusual sounds.
Emergency repair: people decide how to fix the problem.
Root-cause analysis: people determine why it failed.
Disassembly and reassembly: tactile skill depends on people.
Safety control: people enforce lockout and tagout.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a moderately exposed machine-room environment. Systems accelerate inspection and monitoring, while diagnosis and emergency repair still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure means the occupation remains stable. Inspection and recordkeeping activities face replacement, not diagnostic and emergency-repair roles. Workers who detect unusual noises and restore failed equipment become scarcer as productivity rises; those limited to routine rounds face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in electromechanics or vocational training and spend school time dismantling and repairing equipment. Pure inspection is shrinking in the AI era, so develop diagnostic skills early.
Advance from making rounds to diagnosis and emergency repair. Learn predictive maintenance and work toward becoming a lead maintenance technician.
Highlight electromechanical and emergency-repair experience, and specify the equipment you have serviced. Factories value steady, dependable technicians.
Do not select candidates based only on certificates; assess diagnostic ability. Lead technicians who restore equipment during emergencies deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Demand from manufacturing and building operations remains stable.
Monitoring replaces routine inspection; people perform emergency repairs.
Workers with diagnostic skills become more sought after.

body: Machinery maintenance workers perform daily inspections, lubrication, tightening, fault diagnosis, and emergency repairs on general mechanical and electromechanical equipment. They replace wear parts, record work orders, and support scheduled maintenance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监测系统能帮你报异响，但哪儿坏、怎么拆修，还是师傅听针一听就懂。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年维护工人在岗约 5.75 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.59 万人，岗位净减约 0.16 万个，年均产生约 0.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.05 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代维护工，但会加速巡检。传感器、状态监测和工单系统把重复工作提速，维护工从「巡一遍」挪向「诊断、应急抢修、根因分析、保养优化」。真正被挤掉的是纯巡检与记录，会诊断能抢修的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 故障诊断：异响靠人听。
应急抢修：咋修靠人定。
根因分析：为啥坏靠人想。
拆装处置：手感靠人。
安全把控：挂牌靠人守。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的机房区——巡检监测被系统加速，但诊断与抢修还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着岗位稳：被替代的是「巡检与记录」动作，不是「诊断抢修」的岗位。会听异响、能救急的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只巡一遍的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电或技校打底，在校多拆多修。AI 时代纯巡检在缩，早点练诊断。
从「巡线」升级成「做诊断 + 抢抢修」，学预测性维护，争取做主修。
突出机电与抢修经验，写清跟过哪些设备。厂里看重稳和靠谱。
选人别只看证，要看会不会诊断。能救急的主修，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 制造楼宇需求稳。
监测替巡检，人做抢修。
会诊断的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automate captioning and rough cuts, but technical directors still decide which signal to take, how to recover from disruptions, and how to coordinate the production floor.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 167,000 media managers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 175,200 by 2034. That represents roughly 8,200 additional jobs and about 12,800 openings per year, with median annual pay of approximately $83,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace technical directors, but it will accelerate routine workflows. Automated switching, AI captions, and cloud production speed up repetitive operations, shifting directors from watching the console toward technical planning, on-site coordination, emergency response, and team management. Routine switching operators face the greatest pressure, while people who coordinate productions and withstand live-broadcast demands become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Technical plans: people define the architecture.
On-site coordination: people schedule teams.
Emergency response: people resolve crises.
Team management: people lead people.
Quality balance: people make tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderately high-exposure production environment. Systems accelerate switching and captions, while coordination and emergency response still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Routine switching and captioning are the activities being replaced, not technical coordination roles. People who design solutions and withstand live-broadcast emergencies become scarcer as productivity rises. Operators limited to watching consoles face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through a bachelor's degree in broadcasting or media technology and gain extensive practice with production systems and switching. Pure operations are shrinking in the AI era, so develop planning and coordination skills early.
Advance from operations toward technical planning and team management. Learn cloud production and AI tools and seek responsibility for large live broadcasts.
Highlight live-production and emergency-response experience, and specify the program types you supported. Platforms value stability and speed.
Do not assess candidates only on equipment familiarity; look for technical-planning ability. Technical directors who coordinate live broadcasts deserve higher bonuses.

ai_s7_trends: Cloud and remote production become widespread, reducing routine operations.
Streaming media creates incremental opportunities.
Directors with live-production coordination capabilities become more sought after.

body: Media technical directors and managers lead technical coordination for content production. They plan switching, signals, and transmission paths, direct technical teams, safeguard broadcast operations, use production and monitoring systems, and develop and implement technical plans.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can automate captioning and rough cuts, but technical directors still decide which signal to take, how to recover from disruptions, and how to coordinate the production floor.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动切字幕和粗剪，但哪条信号要切、突发怎么救、现场怎么调度，还是技术总监定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年经理媒体在岗约 16.70 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 17.52 万人，净增约 0.82 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.35 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代技术总监，但会加速常规工序。自动切换、AI 字幕与云端制作把重复操作提速，总监从「盯台子」挪向「技术方案、现场调度、突发处置、团队管理」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规切换的操作员，有统筹力能扛直播的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 技术方案：架构靠人定。
现场调度：人靠人排。
突发处置：救火靠人。
团队管理：带人靠人。
质量平衡：取舍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的制作区——切换与字幕被系统加速，但调度与处置还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规切换与字幕」动作，不是「技术统筹」的岗位。有方案能力、能扛直播突发的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会盯台子的操作员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 广电/传媒技术本科打底，在校多摸制作系统和切换。AI 时代纯操作在缩，早点练方案和调度。
从「操作」升级成「做方案 + 管团队」，学云端制作和 AI 工具，争取负责大型直播。
突出直播和突发处置经验，写清跟过哪些类型节目。平台看重稳和快。
选人别只看设备熟，要看有没有方案脑子。能统筹直播的技术总监，值得给高奖金。

ai_s7_trends: 云端与远程制作普及，常规操作缩。
流媒体带来增量机会。
有直播统筹力的总监更抢手。

body: 媒体技术总监/经理主导内容生产的技术统筹，规划切换、信号与链路，指挥技术团队并保障播出安全，运用制作与监控系统，出具技术方案并跟进落地。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated experiments can generate data, but scientists still decide which hypotheses are worth testing and how to explain the mechanism.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 63,700 molecular and cellular biologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 64,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 800 jobs, with roughly 4,800 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $93,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace molecular biologists, but it will reduce standard laboratory work. Automated experiments and high-throughput systems accelerate routine processes, shifting scientists from standard procedures toward experimental design, mechanistic interpretation, and research-direction decisions. People limited to standard procedures will lose ground, while those who can design studies and explain results will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Experimental design: people define the hypothesis.
Mechanism interpretation: people explain the meaning.
Research-direction decisions: people choose the path.
Reviewing negative results: people provide critical reflection.
Cross-disciplinary integration: people identify the connections.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places this occupation in a highly AI-exposed area of laboratory operations. Systems accelerate standard experiments, while people remain essential for design and interpretation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. Standard procedures are being replaced, not experimental-design roles. Scientists who can design studies and explain mechanisms become even scarcer as productivity rises. Laboratory staff limited to standard procedures face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong experimental-design skills from the start of your biology or basic-science training. Purely operational work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop interpretation skills early.
Progress from performing procedures to designing studies + explaining mechanisms. Build interdisciplinary expertise and work toward ownership of a research direction.
Emphasize publications and research focus, and clearly describe the projects you have supported. Employers value consistency and depth.
Do not hire based only on technical procedures. Look for people who think like experimental designers. Core scientists who can explain results deserve premium compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Automated experiments become widespread, reducing routine operations.
Cross-disciplinary integration creates opportunities.
Scientists who explain results well are in greater demand.

body: Molecular and cellular biologists study the structure, function, and interactions of biological molecules and cells, designing experiments to reveal mechanisms of life and disease pathways.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated experiments can generate data, but scientists still decide which hypotheses are worth testing and how to explain the mechanism.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动实验能出数，但哪个假说值得验、机制怎么讲，还是科学家定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年分子与细胞生物学家在岗约 6.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.45 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.48 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.33 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代分子生物学家，但会压缩标准操作。自动实验与高通量把常规流程提速，科学家从「做标准操作」挪向「实验设计、机制解释、方向判断」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准操作的人，会设计能解释的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 实验设计：假说靠人定。
机制解释：意义靠人讲。
方向判断：走向靠人。
阴性复盘：反思靠人。
交叉整合：关联靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的操作区——标准实验被系统加速，但设计与解释还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「做标准操作」动作，不是「实验设计」的岗位。会设计、能解释的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会做标准操作的实验员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 生物/基础起步多练设计，AI 时代纯操作在缩，早点练解释。
从「做操作」升级成「做设计 + 讲机制」，学交叉，争取方向。
突出论文与方向，写清服务过哪些课题。用人方看重稳和深。
选人别只看操作，要看有没有设计脑子。能解释的骨干，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动实验普及，操作缩。
交叉整合带来机会。
会解释的科学家更抢手。

body: 分子与细胞生物学家研究生物分子与细胞的结构、功能与相互作用，设计实验揭示生命机制与疾病通路。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动实验能出数，但哪个假说值得验、机制怎么讲，还是科学家定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Remote guidance can connect an expert to the ambulance, but the rhythm of chest compressions and the feel of inserting a needle still belong to emergency clinicians.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 101,900 paramedics were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 107,000, a net increase of about 5,100 jobs, with about 4,900 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $58,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace paramedics, but it will support decisions. Dispatching, electronic medical records, and remote expert guidance are becoming digital, shifting paramedics from recording details toward on-scene assessment, vascular access, medication administration, and stabilizing vital signs. EMTs limited to basic procedures face the greatest pressure, while professionals who deliver advanced life support become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Wearable monitors transmit data to emergency departments in real time
Prompts and quality control for resuscitation workflows
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent optimization of dispatching and nearest-vehicle assignment
Automated generation of electronic medical records and treatment notes
Automated collection and upload of ambulance equipment data
Real-time connections for remote expert guidance
ai_s3_list: On-scene assessment decisions: people decide whom to treat first.
Tactile skill in vascular access and medication: people insert needles in moving ambulances.
CPR force: people control the rhythm.
Emergency response: people stabilize chaotic scenes.
Communication with patients and families: people manage emotions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure in a supporting role. Systems take over dispatch and records, while people retain their place in on-scene resuscitation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Recording and dispatch tasks face replacement, not ambulance-based resuscitation roles. Remote guidance strengthens paramedics who provide advanced life support and stay composed under pressure. EMTs limited to basic procedures face greater risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through secondary vocational or associate-level emergency care or nursing programs, and practice vascular access and CPR extensively while studying. Basic procedures are shrinking in the AI era, so earn advanced paramedic credentials early.
Advance from basic EMT skills to advanced paramedic practice. Learn airway management and medication administration, and pursue emergency-department or flight-paramedic work.
Highlight field experience and credential level, clearly describing the emergencies you have handled. Emergency-care employers value composure and proficiency.
When hiring, assess composure under pressure, not physical strength alone. People who provide advanced life support deserve higher job grades.

ai_s7_trends: Emergency networks are expanding into underserved areas, sustaining county-level demand.
Remote guidance and wearables strengthen ambulance-based care.
Paramedics who provide advanced life support are in greater demand.

body: Paramedics provide advanced life support before hospital arrival, rapidly assess patients, manage airways, establish intravenous access, administer emergency medications, monitor ECGs, perform defibrillation, and stabilize vital signs during transport so patients reach emergency care safely.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Remote guidance can connect an expert to the ambulance, but the rhythm of chest compressions and the feel of inserting a needle still belong to emergency clinicians.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 远程指导能把专家连到车上，但胸外按压的节奏、扎针的手感，还是急救医护的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年急救医护人员在岗约 10.19 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.70 万人，净增约 0.51 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.49 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代急救医护，但会辅助决策。调度派单、电子病历、远程专家指导被数字化，急救医护从「记单子」挪向「现场评估、穿刺给药、稳住生命体征」。真正被挤掉的是只会基础操作的 EMT，能做高级生命支持的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助分诊与病情严重度判断
可穿戴监护实时回传急诊
抢救流程的提示与质控
ai_s2_auto: 调度派单与就近派车的智能优化
电子病历与处置记录的自动生成
车载设备数据的自动采集上传
远程专家指导的实时连线
ai_s3_list: 现场评估决策：先救谁靠人定。
穿刺给药手感：颠车上要人扎。
心肺复苏力度：节奏靠人控。
突发处置：现场失控要人镇。
医患与家属沟通：情绪靠人接。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的辅助区——派单记录被系统接管，但现场抢救留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「记单派单」动作，不是「车上抢救」的岗位。能做高级生命支持、临场稳的急救医护，反而随远程指导更强大。怕的是只会基础操作的 EMT。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 急救护理类中专大专打底，在校多练穿刺和 CPR。AI 时代基础操作在缩，早点考 paramedic 高级资质。
从「EMT 基础」升级成「paramedic 高级」，学气道与给药，争取转急诊或飞行急救。
突出现场经验和资质等级，写清救过哪些急症。急救招聘看重稳和熟。
招人别只看体力，要看临场稳不稳。能做高级生命支持的，值得给高岗级。

ai_s7_trends: 急救网络下沉，县域需求稳。
远程指导与可穿戴让车上更强大。
能做高级生命支持的 paramedic 更抢手。

body: 急救医护在院前环境提供高级生命支持，进行病情快速评估、气道管理、静脉通路与紧急给药、心电监护与除颤，并在转运中维持生命体征稳定，确保患者安全送达急诊。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 远程指导能把专家连到车上，但胸外按压的节奏、扎针的手感，还是急救医护的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated sorting lines can identify routes, but people still decide how to classify exceptions, route large items, and coordinate the floor.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 106,400 postal service mail sorters, processors, and processing machine operators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 97,500 by 2034, a net loss of about 8,900 jobs, with about 7,800 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $56,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postal mail sorters, but it will reduce standard-item work. Automated sorting and address recognition accelerate routine letters, shifting sorters from standard items toward exception handling, large-item dispatch, and on-site troubleshooting. New workers limited to standard items will be displaced, while people with coordination ability become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Exception judgment: people inspect items.
Large-item dispatch: people determine routes.
On-site troubleshooting: people clear jams.
Pre-holiday surges: people control the pace.
Customer communication: people provide explanations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 places this occupation in a moderately high AI-exposure range. Systems accelerate standard items, but exceptions and dispatch still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is sorting standard items, not on-site coordination. People with judgment and dispatch skills become scarcer as automation rises. Sorters limited to standard items face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Starting with secondary vocational education, practice on real machines. Pure sorting is shrinking in the automated era, so learn dispatch and equipment early.
Advance from standard items to exceptions + dispatch + maintenance, and pursue shift-leader roles.
Emphasize attention to detail and ability to work shifts. Postal employers value reliability and accuracy.
When hiring, assess more than speed; look for coordination judgment. Core staff who lead shifts deserve higher hourly pay.

ai_s7_trends: As automated sorting spreads, standard-item work shrinks.
Exceptions and large items still create opportunities.
People skilled in dispatch and maintenance are more sought after.

body: Postal mail sorters operate sorting and processing equipment, coordinate route-based stacking, scanning, and machine processing of letters and parcels, handle exceptions, and connect with transportation to keep mail moving along the correct routes.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated sorting lines can identify routes, but people still decide how to classify exceptions, route large items, and coordinate the floor.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动分拣线能识别路向，但异常件怎么判、大件怎么走、现场怎么调度，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年邮政服务邮件分拣员、处理员、机器操作员在岗约 10.64 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.75 万人，岗位净减约 0.89 万个，年均产生约 0.78 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.65 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代邮政分拣员，但会压缩标准件。自动分拣与地址识别把常规信函提速，分拣员从「分标准件」挪向「异常件处理、大件调度、现场排故」。真正被挤掉的是只分标准件的新手，有调度力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 异常判断：件靠人看。
大件调度：走法靠人。
现场排故：卡塞靠人。
节前爆量：节奏靠人。
客户沟通：解释靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等偏上 AI 曝光区——标准件被系统加速，但异常与调度还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「分标准件」动作，不是「现场调度」的岗位。有判断力和调度力的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只会分标准件的分拣工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 中专起步多练真机，自动分拣时代纯分件在缩，早点学调度和设备。
从「分标准件」升级成「异常 + 调度 + 维护」，争取班次组长。
突出细心和能熬倒班，邮政看重稳和准。
选人别只看手快，要看有没有调度脑子。能带班的骨干值得给高工时。

ai_s7_trends: 自动分拣普及，标准件缩。
异常与大件仍有机会。
懂调度维护的更抢手。

body: 邮政邮件分拣员操作分拣处理设备，统筹信件包裹的路向归堆、扫描与过机，处理异常并衔接运输，把邮件稳定送上去对的路。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动分拣线能识别路向，但异常件怎么判、大件怎么走、现场怎么调度，还是人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Self-checkout can collect payment automatically, but salespeople still decide how to recommend products, build trust through conversation, and handle returns and exchanges.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 3,936,700 retail salespersons were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 3,917,100 by 2034, a net loss of about 19,600 jobs, with approximately 555,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $34,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace retail salespeople, but it will reduce standardized roles. Self-checkout, cashierless stores, and online price comparison speed up routine transactions, shifting salespeople from processing payments and orders to experiential recommendations, trust-building, and member retention. People who only handle standard transactions face displacement, while those who can recommend and cultivate customers become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Experiential recommendations: people understand the context.
Trust-based business: people sustain relationships.
Returns and exchanges: people manage emotions.
High-value sales: people conduct negotiations.
On-site response: people handle exceptions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates medium AI exposure in sales. Systems accelerate standard transactions, but people retain an essential role in experience and trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is the task of collecting payment and processing orders, not the role of managing customer experiences. People who recommend effectively and cultivate members become even scarcer as productivity rises. Salespeople who only stand at a counter and collect payment face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in a store and practice product knowledge and sales conversations. Pure order processing is shrinking in the AI era, so develop customer-management skills early.
Advance from processing orders to recommending experiences, and learn member engagement and high-value sales.
Highlight your sales results and category experience, and specify which brands you have worked with.
Do not select candidates only for charm; assess whether they think like operators.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service and cashierless stores are spreading.
Experiential recommendations are more valuable.
Member engagement is becoming central.

body: Retail salespersons lead merchandise sales and customer service, coordinating reception, recommendations, transactions, and after-sales service while using product knowledge and sales techniques to close sales.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Self-checkout can collect payment automatically, but salespeople still decide how to recommend products, build trust through conversation, and handle returns and exchanges.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自助结账能自动收钱，但怎么推荐、怎么聊成信任、怎么处理退换，还是销售定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年零售销售员在岗约 393.67 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 391.71 万人，岗位净减约 1.96 万个，年均产生约 55.58 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.46 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代零售销售，但会压缩标准岗。自助结账、无人店与线上比价把常规交易提速，销售从「收钱开单」挪向「体验推荐、信任经营、会员复购」。真正被挤的是只做标准交易的，有推荐力能经营的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 体验推荐：场景靠人。
信任经营：关系靠人。
退换处理：情绪靠人。
高客单成交：谈靠人。
现场应变：异常靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的销售区——标准交易被系统加速，但体验与信任还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「收钱开单」动作，不是「体验经营」的岗位。有推荐力、能经营会员的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会站柜台收钱的销售。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从门店起步多练产品和话术，AI 时代纯开单在缩，早点练经营。
从开单升级成体验推荐，学会员与高客单。
突出业绩与品类经验，写清跟过哪些品牌。
选人别只看嘴甜，要看有没有经营脑子。

ai_s7_trends: 自助与无人店普及。
体验式推荐更值钱。
会员经营成核心。

body: 零售销售员主导商品销售与顾客服务，统筹接待、推荐、成交与售后，运用产品知识与话术达成销售。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自助结账能自动收钱，但怎么推荐、怎么聊成信任、怎么处理退换，还是销售定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can score assessments and produce reports, but school psychologists still observe children, build trust, and decide how to communicate with families and schools.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 67,200 school psychologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 67,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 500 jobs, with about 3,800 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $86,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace school psychologists, but it will assist them. Systems accelerate assessment scoring and report drafts, moving psychologists from calculating scales toward observation, empathy, intervention design, and family-school collaboration. People who only produce report templates face displacement, while clinically skilled and empathetic professionals become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Clinical observation: people recognize a student's condition.
Trust building: people build relationships.
Intervention design: people build the plan.
Family-school collaboration: people choose the words.
Crisis judgment: people assess severity.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in a moderately high exposure range. Systems accelerate documentation and assessment, but people remain essential for observation and empathy.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces report templates, not psychological intervention. Clinically skilled and empathetic people become scarcer as efficiency rises. Psychologists who only apply templates without observing students face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build foundations in both psychology and education, plan for a master's degree and certification, and recognize that pure report production is shrinking in the AI era.
Advance from producing reports to observation + intervention design and learn data-based progress tracking.
Highlight case and collaboration experience and specify the grade levels you have served. Schools value practical results.
Do not select people based only on credentials; assess their observational thinking. Core professionals who intervene independently merit higher ranks.

ai_s7_trends: Automated assessment is spreading and accelerating documentation.
Greater attention to student mental health is creating jobs.
School psychologists with clinical skills are increasingly sought after.

body: School psychologists conduct psychological assessments, counseling, and behavioral interventions in schools. They address learning, emotional, and behavioral problems and connect families, teachers, and professional resources.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can score assessments and produce reports, but school psychologists still observe children, build trust, and decide how to communicate with families and schools.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能跑测评和出报告，但观察孩子、建立信任、家校怎么谈，还是心理老师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年学校心理学家在岗约 6.72 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.77 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.38 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.69 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代学校心理学家，但会做辅助。测评打分与报告草稿被系统提速，心理老师从「算量表」挪向「观察、共情、干预设计与家校协同」。真正被挤掉的是只出报告模板的，有临床力能共情的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 临床观察：状态靠人看。
信任建立：关系靠人建。
干预设计：方案靠人搭。
家校协同：话术靠人说。
危机判断：轻重靠人分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——文书与测评被系统加速，但观察与共情还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「出报告模板」动作，不是「做心理干预」的岗位。有临床力、能共情的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会套模板、不观察的心理老师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 心理+教育双底子，规划硕士与考证，AI 时代纯报告在缩。
从「出报告」升级成「做观察 + 搭干预」，学数据化跟踪。
突出个案与协同经验，写清服务过哪些学段。学校看重落地。
选人别只看证书，要看有没有观察脑子。能独立干预的骨干，值得给高职级。

ai_s7_trends: 测评自动化普及，文书提速。
校园心理受重视增岗。
有临床力的心理老师更抢手。

body: 学校心理学家在学校场域内实施心理测评、咨询与行为干预，协助学习、情绪与行为问题，连接家庭、教师与专业资源。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能跑测评和出报告，但观察孩子、建立信任、家校怎么谈，还是心理老师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can draft and translate, but writers still decide how to organize information, assess audiences, and ensure accuracy.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 56,400 technical writers were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 56,900 by 2034, a net gain of about 500 jobs, with about 4,500 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $91,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace technical writers, but it will reduce the value of routine drafts. AI accelerates first drafts and translation, shifting writers from producing text toward information architecture, audience analysis, accuracy review, and system maintenance. People who only transfer and proofread content will face pressure.
ai_s3_list: Information architecture: People organize content.
Audience analysis: People determine levels.
Accuracy review: People decide what is correct.
Product understanding: People understand the logic.
System maintenance: People preserve consistency.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 8/10 places technical writers in the high AI-exposure range. AI accelerates routine drafts, but people remain responsible for architecture and review.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces first-draft transfer work, not information architecture and accuracy review. People who only write without understanding the product are most vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Develop writing skills and learn a technical field. Pure writing work is shrinking in the AI era.
Advance from writing documents to designing architecture and reviewing quality. Learn information design and relevant tools.
Highlight industry and technical backgrounds and specify the documentation systems you have managed.
Assess candidates' architecture and accuracy, not only prose quality.

ai_s7_trends: AI reduces first-draft work.
Information architecture becomes more important.
Accuracy reviewers are in greater demand.

body: Technical writers research products and systems and write user manuals, API documentation, help center content, and release notes. They connect development, testing, and support teams to keep information accurate, usable, and consistent.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can draft and translate, but writers still decide how to organize information, assess audiences, and ensure accuracy.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能起草和翻译，但信息怎么组织、受众怎么判断、准确性怎么把关，还是写作者定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年技术写作者在岗约 5.64 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.69 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.45 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.17 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代技术写作者，但会压低常规草稿。AI 把初稿与翻译提速，写作者从「码字」挪向「信息架构、受众判断、准确性把关与体系维护」。真正被挤的是只做搬运校对的人。
ai_s3_list: 信息架构：组织靠人。
受众判断：分级靠人。
准确性把关：对错靠人。
产品理解：逻辑靠人。
体系维护：一致靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明技术写作者处于高 AI 曝光区——常规草稿被加速，但架构与把关还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是初稿搬运，不是信息架构与准确性把关。怕的是只会码字、不懂产品的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 练写作也学一门技术，AI 时代纯码字在缩。
从「写文档」升级成「做架构 + 把关」，学信息设计与工具。
突出行业与技术背景，写明管过哪些文档体系。
选人看架构与准确性，别只看文笔。

ai_s7_trends: AI 压初稿。
信息架构升。
准确性把关更抢手。

body: 技术写作者研究产品与系统，编写用户手册、API 文档、帮助中心与发布说明，衔接研发、测试与支持，保障信息准确、可用与一致。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能起草和翻译，但信息怎么组织、受众怎么判断、准确性怎么把关，还是写作者定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can predict turbine failures, but a person still has to climb up, feel, and listen to determine exactly how tight a bolt should be or whether a cracked blade must be sent back to the factory.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 13,600 wind turbine service technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 20,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 6,900 jobs, with roughly 2,300 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $62,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace wind turbine service technicians: models cannot take over physical-world tasks such as working at height, making hands-on judgments, and responding to emergencies on site. AI can help with failure prediction, data analysis, and schedule optimization so technicians make fewer unnecessary trips, but a person still has to turn the final wrench.
ai_s2_accel: AI forecasting and scheduling of spare-parts inventory
ai_s2_auto: Digital work-order scheduling and spare-parts management
Automated SCADA data collection and alerts
Automated generation of inspection records and reports
Assistance with preliminary remote fault screening
ai_s3_list: Working at height and safety judgment: risk awareness can mean the difference between life and death.
Fault isolation: drawing conclusions from unusual sounds, vibrations, and parameter changes.
Hands-on work: precise feel for disassembly, assembly, torque, and clearances.
On-site emergency response: handling sudden failures and severe weather.
Cross-system judgment: integrated mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic analysis.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 means wind turbine maintenance is a physical and technical occupation with moderately high AI exposure: AI is enhancing data monitoring and failure prediction, but installation, maintenance, and work at height in the physical world cannot be automated in the near term. AI helps diagnose the condition; people perform the operation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure is not a bad thing. Technicians who can interpret data and use diagnostic tools can advance from repair workers to preventive-maintenance specialists, increasing both their on-site value and income.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This is one of the better-value paths among skilled trades: an associate degree can be enough to enter, and the policy outlook for renewable energy is strong. Study mechatronics, wind energy, or electrical technology; earn electrical and work-at-height certifications while in school; then join a wind farm after graduation. The early years are demanding, but experience becomes highly valuable.

Move toward offshore wind and fault diagnostics. Offshore work pays higher allowances and has a greater talent shortage. Learn SCADA data analysis and vibration diagnostics, advancing from performing maintenance to diagnosing and troubleshooting faults; your bargaining power will be entirely different.

People with electrical or mechanical maintenance backgrounds can transition quickly, but they should be prepared to live at remote wind farms far from home. In interviews, emphasize work-at-height experience, electrical troubleshooting cases, and safety awareness. Those without experience can start in ground-based maintenance support.

Staff shortages are normal in wind power operations and maintenance. Retention depends on transparent allowances, advancement paths, and decent living support at project sites. Instead of paying a premium to compete for experienced workers, build an apprenticeship program, train your own people, and cover safety training and certification costs.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time collection of turbine operating parameters
Early detection of bearing and gearbox faults
Automated image detection of blade cracks
Remote expert annotation of repair locations
Fall protection, twin lanyards, and rescue systems

ai_s7_trends: As the installed turbine fleet ages, demand for maintenance and retrofits continues to grow.
Offshore wind is becoming the main source of new jobs, and offshore skills are in demand.
As predictive maintenance spreads, technicians are evolving into diagnostic specialists.

body: Wind turbine service technicians install, commission, maintain, and repair wind turbines, including inspecting towers and blades, maintaining drive-train and electrical systems, monitoring safety, and optimizing performance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can predict turbine failures, but a person still has to climb up, feel, and listen to determine exactly how tight a bolt should be or whether a cracked blade must be sent back to the factory.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能预测风机故障，但「螺栓到底拧多紧、叶片裂纹该不该返厂」，还得人爬上去摸一摸、听一听。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年风力涡轮机服务技术员在岗约 1.36 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.05 万人，净增约 0.69 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代风力涡轮机服务技术员：高空作业、手感判断、现场应急处置这些物理世界的活，模型替代不了。AI 能帮的是故障预测、数据分析、排期优化，让技术员少跑冤枉路，但最后那一扳手还是得人来拧。
ai_s2_accel: 振动分析与轴承寿命预测
无人机与叶片影像自动检测
AR 远程专家指导维修
备件库存 AI 预测调度
ai_s2_auto: 工单排期与备件管理数字化
SCADA 数据自动采集与告警
巡检记录与报告自动生成
远程故障初步筛查辅助
ai_s3_list: 高空作业与安全判断：风险意识决定生死。
故障定位：从异响、振动、参数变化综合判断。
手工操作：拆装、力矩、间隙的精确手感。
现场应急：突发故障与恶劣天气下的处置。
跨系统判断：机械、电气、液压综合分析。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明风电检修是「中高曝光」的体力+技术岗：数据监测、故障预测正在被 AI 强化，但物理世界的安装、检修、高空作业短时间无法自动化，属于「AI 帮你看病，人负责开刀」的组合。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不是坏事：会读数据、会用诊断工具的技术员，能从「修理工」升级成「预防性维护专家」，驻场价值和收入都更高。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这是技术型蓝领里性价比不错的赛道：大专学历就能入行，新能源方向政策确定性强。建议选机电、风电、电气类专业，在校把电工证、高空证考了，毕业直接进风场，前期苦，攒够经验很吃香。
往海上风电和故障诊断方向走：海风补贴高、人才更缺；把 SCADA 数据分析、振动诊断学起来，从「执行检修」向「诊断排故」升级，议价能力完全不同。
有电工、机械维修背景的转这行上手快，但要做好「常驻风场、离家远」的准备。面试突出登高作业经验、电气排故案例和安全意识；没经验的可从地面辅助检修做起。
风电运维缺人是行业常态，留人靠「补贴透明 + 晋升通道 + 驻场生活保障」。与其高价抢有经验的人，不如建师徒制自己带人，把安全培训和证书费用包了。

海上风电成为新增就业主力，出海技能吃香。
预测性维护普及，技术员向诊断专家转型。
